Radio Traders // Skin Maker

Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

1Images

✕Walkiedrop or click
(tall images work best)
✕Ham radiodrop or click
(wide images work best)

2Fit

Drag the preview to move it. Mouse wheel zooms.

3Readability

4Name it

Radio Traders has 8 fixed skin names. Your skin takes over the one you pick, so choose one you won't miss.

5Export

  1. Unzip the download into Zomboid/mods/ (you'll get one RT_Skin_… folder).
  2. In game, enable Radio Traders and your new skin mod.
  3. Mod Options → Radio skin → pick the name shown after export.
  4. Restart the game after making or changing a skin.
